Founded in Nigeria (2014) and incorporated in Canada (2024), WESAC’s work is aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 5: Gender Equality. We believe every woman deserves opportunity, dignity, and a strong community. Our programs are designed to build confidence, foster independence, and drive lasting social and economic impact.
